feats.name: Close shave
feats.text: Deliver a job after a trace came within 3 seconds of you.

feats.name: Never there
feats.text: Deliver a job with no trace started and no line of yours left behind.

feats.name: Clean sheet
feats.text: Deliver 10 jobs in a row with no line of yours left in a log.

feats.name: Spotless
feats.text: Deliver 25 jobs in a row with no line of yours left in a log.

feats.name: In and out
feats.text: Deliver a job within 20 game minutes of taking it.

feats.name: Bare-faced
feats.text: Deliver a job worth 5 rating or more without a single relay.

feats.name: Two lines open
feats.text: Hold three connections open at once on a job.

feats.name: Frozen
feats.text: Deliver a job after jamming its trace.

feats.name: Traced back
feats.text: Trace an attacker back to their own machine.

feats.name: Untouched
feats.text: Reach the Wraith title without a trace ever landing.

feats.name: Smooth talker
feats.text: Talk someone out of a password.

feats.name: Bench work
feats.text: Build a program at the Workbench.

feats.name: Back on your feet
feats.text: Deliver a clean job straight after a trace landed.

feats.name: The end of it
feats.text: See the story to one of its endings.
